description:
About Amperos

Amperos is healthcare's first AI-native denial management and revenue recovery platform. Our agentic AI works claims end-to-end, from portal follow-ups and payor calls to appeals and medical records, so providers can resolve more denials, recover more revenue, and focus on what matters most: serving patients.

We just closed a $16M Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with continued participation from Uncork Capital and Neo. We're still small, still early, and going after a $260B+ problem that's only getting worse. If you want to work on hard problems that matter, alongside people who care deeply about the mission (and each other), we'd love to meet you.

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Payment Posting Specialist with 2+ years of experience in RCM to join our team. You'll work at the intersection of traditional claim submission or payment posting workflows and cutting-edge AI, helping our customers submit claims accurately and efficiently while ensuring our automation systems perform at the highest standard.

You'll be responsible for entering charges, verifying claim accuracy, managing charge submissions to insurance companies, and tracking claims through posting and adjudication. As our product and customer base evolve, your responsibilities may shift to align with near-term priorities—this is a role with meaningful ownership and room to grow.

What you'll do

Payment Posting:

  • Post payments, adjustments, and denials from ERAs, EOBs, and lockbox files into customer PM systems and Amperos platforms

  • Balance daily batches, reconcile to bank deposits, and resolve missing or mismatched ERAs

  • Flag underpayments and denials

  • Resolve unapplied cash, credit balances, refunds, and recoupments, and transfer balances

What we're looking for

  • At least 2 years of experience in medical billing, charge entry, or coding verification

  • Strong working knowledge of medical coding

  • Experience with leading PM systems, including eCW, ModMed, Athenahealth, and more

  • Solid understanding of insurance claim submission requirements and pre-authorization processes

  • Ability to identify coding errors and clinical editing issues before claim submission

  • Detail-oriented, organized, and reliable in documentation and follow-through

  • Ability to work US hours (9am–6pm ET) to collaborate with our team and customers

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where processes and priorities can change

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation with eligibility for a bonus on anniversary date

  • Paid sick days and vacation days

  • Meal stipends

  • Opportunity to grow with a rapidly scaling company and be an early member of a global billing team, as we expand our billing team in India

Our Hiring Promise: A safe, transparent process

Amperos will never as you for money at any point in the hiring process. That includes application fees, payment for equipment or training, or a fee to move your application forward. No one at Amperos, or anyone acting on our behalf, is authorized to request payment from a candidate.

Our Values

  • Lead with Empathy - Great products and teams are built on empathy—whether for our customers, users, or team members. We take the time to walk in others' shoes, listen actively, and truly understand their challenges, needs, and perspectives.

  • Humbly Ambitious - We combine humility with ambition. No task is beneath us, and no challenge too big. Greatness comes from being willing to do whatever it takes, while having the courage to take bold risks and learn from failures.

  • Radical Agency - Own your domain. Drive initiatives with autonomy and accountability. Think deeply, communicate with the team, and maintain a bias for action.

Amperos never asks candidates for money at any stage of the hiring process, including fees for interviews, processing, or recruitment. No one at Amperos, or acting on our behalf, is authorized to request payment. If you are asked for payment, please do not send any money and report it confidentially here: Report a Hiring Concern
